hooks.name: Kiro journal

action.prompt: Append a dated entry to docs/kiro-journal.md: which spec and task just finished, what changed, which tests ran and their result, and any finding worth noting (a bug a test caught, a measured number). Under 80 words. Create the file with a "# Kiro journal" heading if it doesn't exist. Don't edit any other file.

hooks.description: Writes a short dated journal entry after each spec task, for the hackathon write-up.
